name: MonarchListRow
title: List row
wrapsNative: HStack rows for a List or a stack, with listRowInsets, listRowSeparator and listRowBackground
summary: A row of a list: a leading icon, a title with supporting text, a trailing view or a chevron, and a hairline divider under it.
whenToUse: For the rows of a list of records, settings or people, on the Monarch canvas.
whenNotToUse: For a table of columns use MonarchDataTable. For a grouped settings screen of system controls the system List and Form fit.
api: MonarchListRow.init(_ title: String, subtitle: String? = nil, systemImage: String? = nil, showsChevron: Bool = false, showsDivider: Bool = true, trailing: () -> Trailing)

options.name: systemImage
options.description: An SF Symbol before the text.

options.name: showsChevron
options.description: A chevron at the end, for a row that opens something.

options.name: showsDivider
options.description: The hairline under the row, inset by the row padding.

options.name: trailing
options.description: A view at the end, such as a badge or a value.

states.name: default
states.description: 44 point minimum height, 16 point side padding, 12 point gaps.

appearance: The title uses the default text role and the supporting text the muted role. The divider is the subtle border role, inset by the row padding. The row draws no fill: it sits on the list background.
platformNotes: The system List draws its own insets, separators and fill. In a List, add monarchListRowStyle() to the row and monarchCanvas() to the list so the screen sits on the Monarch canvas. The web has no single list item; the row follows the menu item and description list metrics.
accessibility: The title, supporting text and trailing text are read as one element; the icon and chevron are hidden.
The row is at least 44 points high and grows with Dynamic Type.
The chevron flips in a right-to-left layout.
edgeCases: A long title wraps; the row grows.
Wrap the row in a Button or NavigationLink to make it act.
